title: Stubbornness is not a spiritual path
summary: This meets the seeker who keeps trying to force arrival through self-will. The line refuses that posture and says true service begins where the Lord Himself draws you near.
takeaway: Stop forcing what only grace can open.
lifeApplication: When you feel yourself straining to manufacture certainty, stop and unclench the brow. Ask to be attached to the path rather than to your own method of reaching it.

source.shortMeaning: Self-will cannot find the One; grace must draw the seeker near.
source.lifeApplication: When striving gets hard, ask to be led rather than to force arrival.

evidence.coreClaim: Self-will cannot find the One; grace must draw the seeker near.
evidence.turn: The path becomes visible when service turns fruitful.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you feel yourself straining to manufacture certainty, stop and unclench the brow. Ask to be attached to the path rather than to your own method of reaching it.
